name: Mystique Soup

descriptions.normal: A drink made from Grainfruit. Originally invented as a type of medicine by a certain shaman of the Masters of the Night-Wind, the recipe has been altered with the passage of time and is now a common drink at social gatherings.
descriptions.suspicious: A drink made from Grainfruit. One sip and all your taste buds begin to tingle. It's almost like an "endless aftertaste," for the flavor is so intense that it lingers on the tip of your tongue, and even drinking water cannot wash it away.
descriptions.delicious: A drink made from Grainfruit. The cup is full of still, bright liquid, with the magnificent hues of a gemstone with a stunning gradient. Its subtle fragrance and delicate sweetness combine to evoke the mysteries of an ancient tribe, leaving those that partake yearning for more.

effectTexts.normal: A little surprise from the Masters of the Night-Wind.

recipeHint: Reputation Level 2 with Masters of the Night-Wind
sources: Redemption code from Genshin Impact × TOMORO Coffee
